_schema._comment: Player-scaled ability costs (dispatch Q31, projects/heresy-rising/dispatches/2026-07-27-q31-interrogator-cost.md). Two entry shapes: (1) a CURVE — baseValues/floors/perPlayerCount, exactly as before; lives under _curves, keyed by a balance-descriptive name, not a role id. (2) an ALIAS — {curve, tierKeys}, where tierKeys is this role's own tier names in the SAME ORDER as the curve's baseValues keys (positional mapping, e.g. curve 't1'/'t2'/'t3' <-> role 'whisper'/'hymn'/'litany'). A role only needs its own inline curve block (shape 1, unaliased) if its costs genuinely diverge from every existing curve — reuse an existing curve via shape 2 whenever the numbers match, so N roles sharing a balance curve cost one 2-line alias each instead of N copies of the same table. perPlayerCount is precomputed for the engine's hot path; heresy-server/src/mechanics/scaledCosts.js's validateScaledCosts() regenerates every curve's table from its own baseValues+floors+costFormula and must match exactly — edit baseValues/floors and regenerate, don't hand-edit perPlayerCount out of sync. Rounding uses round-half-up (JS Math.round), not banker's rounding.

standard._comment: Shared by every role below as of 2026-07-28 (interrogator, priest, heretic-priest all reuse this curve unmodified). If a future role needs different numbers, add a new named curve here rather than editing this one out from under the existing three.
